snippet.title: WHAT THE CAR? x GOAT SIMULATOR+ | New Episode OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
New update for WHAT THE CAR? - Available on Apple Arcade

The new crossover introduces CAR’s latest partner in chaos: Pilgor the GOAT!  With fresh levels and car forms, run amok in the new Episode that is a simulation of the simulation of all time. 

The update includes:
- 11 new levels
- Explosions!!!
- New achievements 
- Licking physics (slurp)
- Waterslide
- Dancing cheese?
- A fully functioning trampoline
- 10 Golden Goat Trophies to collect
- Secrets!
- Unlockable Goat Skin for Car (don’t worry, Pilgor gets to keep hers)
- Stonehenge.

Released on Apple Arcade: https://apple.co/what-the-car 
Apple Arcade subscription required to play WHAT THE CAR?

#whatthecar #goatsimulator #newrelease #whatthegames
